subject: Nanotechnology
title: Quantum Effects Emerge
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Quantum Effects Emerge.

hook.text: Shrink a semiconductor to a few nanometers and electrons act like waves trapped in a box.

buildup.text: In bulk, electrons roam freely. Confine them in a nanoparticle and energy levels split apart.

discovery.text: Smaller particles have larger band gaps — quantum dots glow different colors based on size alone.

twist.text: Grow the dot a few nanometers bigger and the glow shifts from blue to red — same material.

climax.text: Samsung QLED TVs use quantum dots sized to emit exact colors — atomic-level precision.

punchline.text: Shrink the electron's cage and it changes color.

quiz.question: What causes quantum dots to emit different colors?
options: Different chemical dyes coat each dot
Particle size determines the band gap and emission wavelength
External magnetic fields shift the color
